title: Track the upstream main Linux CI failure on anyps5-2 runners (#24834)
objective: Issue #24834 (opened 2026-11-21): agc_driver_scattered_runs and agc_driver_image_table_packed_guards fail on every main Linux job on the anyps5-2 runners since 17 Nov, and pass on anyps5-3.
description: Issue #24834 (opened 2026-11-21): agc_driver_scattered_runs and agc_driver_image_table_packed_guards fail on every main Linux job on the anyps5-2 runners since 17 Nov, and pass on anyps5-3. Find out whether the ORB-002 container reproduces it and which host property (CPU, Mesa, kernel) matters, so ORBIS does not blame integrated PRs for it.
acceptance: Reproduced or not reproduced in the ORBIS container, with Mesa version and CPU model
Both tests added to an ORBIS known-failure list with the issue number if they fail on main
Host properties that differ between passing and failing runs listed
